product_metadata.title: Satya 12 Pack 15g Incense Sticks - Egyptian Musk
description: Satya 12 Pack of Egyptian Musk. There is 15 grams of incense in each pack. Thus, the total weight is 80 for box. The smell is of Egyptian Musk.
